svg.text: Rehost is the default for a validated label server: block replication keeps the validated state identical. The target cloud picks the tool; only an unsupported or drifted OS justifies a rebuild.

svg.text: Elapsed: 2–3 weeks, with a 4-hour cutover window and a source VM that is only ever shut down, never modified. Controls: CM-3 (two changes), CP-10 (retained source), SC-28 (encrypted replicated disks).

text.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Segoe UI Web', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Generalised design: no client names, tenant IDs, addresses or data. Icons are simplified originals, not Microsoft artwork.
